meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 Centinela(QA)agent 做深度安全审计:跑 OWASP Top 10 检查、扫描硬编码密钥、审计依赖 CVE,把结论写入 docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md,并给出结论。它只记录问题,不修漏洞。
howto.when: 在发布前、涉及认证/授权或数据处理的重大改动后、定期安全复审,以及新增依赖或外部集成时使用。未指定范围则审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 审计整个 src/ 目录

say.text: 把这次审计的发现按修复顺序整理给 Dev

howto.what_en: Claude runs a deep security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: OWASP Top 10 checks, secrets scan, dependency CVE audit, and a report at docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md with a verdict. It documents findings, never fixes them.
howto.when_en: Use before a release, after major changes touching auth, authorization, or data handling, for periodic reviews, or when adding dependencies or integrations. Without a scope, the whole src/ directory is audited.

say_en.text: Sort this audit's findings into a fix order for the Dev agent
